parameters.content:
## Review Response Automation Workflow

Starter template from agentmelt.com — configure before running:

1. Fill in "Config (edit me)" (name, approver, quiet hours; test_mode stays on for the first week).
2. Add credentials to every service node (Anthropic, mail, CRM, database…).
3. Replace placeholder URLs, queries and field mappings with yours.
4. Set the trigger: Polls each platform's API or a review-aggregation provider hourly; negative reviews trigger immediate alerts.
5. Keep the gates: 'Needs a person?' after every AI step, 'Approved?' after the approval — wire their dead ends to a sheet or a channel.
6. Keep the guardrails:
   - Negative and sensitive reviews are never answered publicly without a person's approval.
   - Replies never dispute facts in public, mention other customers, or reveal personal data.
   - Positive-review auto-posting is enabled only after a calibration period and can be turned off per location.
   - Platform rules (no incentives, no soliciting removal) are enforced in the response rules.

Full blueprint and pricing: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/review-response-automation/
Want it built and run for you? $197/month · custom $2,000–3,500 one-time

nodes.name: Config (edit me)
nodes.notes:
Fill these in once; every later node reads them as $('Config (edit me)').item.json.config.*

test_mode = true: log what the workflow would write, without writing it, for the first week.
approval_mode = true: the approval node waits for a person; switch off per message type once it has earned it.

Also point the nodes at your own sources:
- Review platforms (Google, Yelp, Trustpilot, Facebook, app stores) or an aggregator
- CRM / booking / POS for customer context
- Business voice guide and response rules
- Location and manager directory

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Draft the response" step of the Review Response Automation Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: Positive: a specific thank-you that echoes what they praised, in the business voice, varied so replies never read as templated. Negative: an empathetic acknowledgement, no defensiveness, an offer to resolve offline with a named contact.

Rules:
- Negative and sensitive reviews are never answered publicly without a person's approval.
- Replies never dispute facts in public, mention other customers, or reveal personal data.
- Positive-review auto-posting is enabled only after a calibration period and can be turned off per location.
- Platform rules (no incentives, no soliciting removal) are enforced in the response rules.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.

nodes.name: IF: Route negatives to a person first
nodes.notes:
Route negatives to a person first

Reviews below a rating threshold or mentioning safety, discrimination or legal issues go to the manager with the draft and the context; nothing is posted until they decide.

nodes.name: Wait: Approve and post
nodes.notes:
Approve and post

Drafts wait for one-click approval by the owner or location manager; approved replies post through the platform API. Optional auto-post for 5-star reviews after a calibration period.

nodes.name: Google Sheets: Track resolution
nodes.notes:
Track resolution

Negative reviews get a resolution status; follow-up reminders until closed; the reviewer's later rating change is recorded.
